section: Distributive justice and inclusive growth - concept, indicators, policy instruments
subsections: Trickle-down vs direct attack on poverty
Inclusive Development Index (World Economic Forum) - India's position

accepted.s: Which one of the following best describes the trickle-down approach to economic development?
o: Targeted food and cash transfers to vulnerable households
Growth through tax cuts and business incentives, expected to spread benefits to all
Universal provision of free health and education services
accepted.x: The trickle-down approach assumes that growth generated through tax cuts and business incentives will spread to all sections of society.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the defining logic of competing approaches.
accepted.sec: Trickle-down vs direct attack on poverty

accepted.s: Which of the following is a major criticism of the trickle-down approach?
o: It prevents all forms of private investment
It gives excessive importance to community participation
It widens inequality and may miss vulnerable sections
It depends entirely on food transfers
accepted.x: Critics argue that trickle-down growth can widen inequality and fail to reach vulnerable groups.
accepted.tq: Identify the criticism associated with an economic approach.
accepted.sec: Trickle-down vs direct attack on poverty

accepted.s: The growth-first strategy followed during the early Five-Year Plans is associated with which approach?
accepted.x: The early Plans are cited as an example of a growth-first, trickle-down strategy.
accepted.tq: Match the historical example with the correct conceptual approach.
accepted.sec: Trickle-down vs direct attack on poverty

accepted.s: Which of the following best represents a direct attack on poverty?
o: Targeted wage and self-employment programmes along with food and cash transfers
Tax reductions for businesses without targeted support
Reliance only on aggregate GDP growth
accepted.x: A direct attack on poverty uses targeted wage and self-employment measures together with food and cash transfers.
accepted.tq: Apply the definition to a policy combination.
accepted.sec: Trickle-down vs direct attack on poverty

accepted.s: The policy approach described as beginning with the Fifth Plan and associated with the slogan ‘Garibi Hatao’ is:
accepted.x: The direct attack on poverty approach is associated with the Fifth Plan onwards and the ‘Garibi Hatao’ emphasis.
accepted.tq: Use the plan-period marker to identify the policy approach.
accepted.sec: Trickle-down vs direct attack on poverty

accepted.s: Which of the following programmes are cited as examples of a direct attack on poverty?
accepted.x: VB-G RAM G and DAY-NRLM are identified as examples of direct poverty-attack measures.
accepted.tq: Recognise schemes by their policy category.
accepted.sec: Trickle-down vs direct attack on poverty

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the welfare approach:
1. It emphasises safety nets.
2. It includes health and education as important welfare instruments.
3. Nordic states are cited as an example of this approach.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The welfare approach includes safety nets, health and education, and Nordic states are cited as an example.
accepted.tq: Combine the defining features and example of one approach.
accepted.sec: Trickle-down vs direct attack on poverty

accepted.s: Community participation through the self-help group movement is most closely associated with which approach?
accepted.x: The bottom-up approach relies on community participation, for which the self-help group movement is an example.
accepted.tq: Link the institutional example to the underlying approach.
accepted.sec: Trickle-down vs direct attack on poverty

accepted.s: The Inclusive Development Index (IDI) of the World Economic Forum is intended to measure development:
accepted.x: The WEF’s IDI measures development beyond GDP by incorporating growth, inclusion and sustainability-related dimensions.
accepted.tq: Identify the distinguishing purpose of an index.
accepted.sec: Inclusive Development Index (World Economic Forum) - India's position

accepted.s: India ranked at which position in the World Economic Forum’s Inclusive Development Index 2018 among emerging economies?
accepted.x: India was ranked 62nd among 74 emerging economies in the IDI 2018.
accepted.tq: Check both the rank and the denominator together.
accepted.sec: Inclusive Development Index (World Economic Forum) - India's position

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly lists the three pillars of the Inclusive Development Index?
o: Growth and development; inclusion; intergenerational equity and sustainability
GDP growth; inflation control; fiscal consolidation
accepted.x: The three pillars are growth and development, inclusion, and intergenerational equity and sustainability.
accepted.tq: Recall the complete three-part structure of an index.
accepted.sec: Inclusive Development Index (World Economic Forum) - India's position

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Approach)
a. Trickle-down
b. Direct attack on poverty
c. Welfare
 d. Bottom-up
List-II (Illustration)
i. Nordic states
ii. SHG movement
iii. Early Plans’ growth-first strategy
iv. Fifth Plan onwards ‘Garibi Hatao’

Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
accepted.x: Trickle-down corresponds to the early Plans’ growth-first strategy; direct attack to ‘Garibi Hatao’; welfare to Nordic states; and bottom-up to the SHG movement.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair and eliminate mismatched combinations.
accepted.sec: Trickle-down vs direct attack on poverty

accepted.s: Under Annadata Sukhibhava, the annual benefit to each farmer family is:
accepted.x: Annadata Sukhibhava provides Rs 20,000 per year to each farmer family.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the total benefit from its component contributions.

accepted.s: The Rs 20,000 annual benefit under Annadata Sukhibhava consists of:
o: Rs 10,000 each from the State and PM-KISAN
Rs 15,000 from the State and Rs 5,000 from PM-KISAN
Rs 14,000 from the State and Rs 6,000 from PM-KISAN
Rs 14,000 from PM-KISAN and Rs 6,000 from the State
accepted.x: The benefit comprises Rs 14,000 from the State and Rs 6,000 through PM-KISAN.
accepted.tq: Split a composite figure into its stated components.

accepted.s: Which category is specifically covered under Annadata Sukhibhava in addition to farmer families?
accepted.x: Annadata Sukhibhava also covers tenant farmers.
accepted.tq: Test the inclusion or exclusion of a beneficiary category.

accepted.s: Thalliki Vandanam provides an annual amount of how much to mothers of school-going children?
accepted.x: Thalliki Vandanam provides Rs 15,000 per year to mothers of school-going children.
accepted.tq: Use nearby welfare figures as numerical distractors.

accepted.s: The allocation for Thalliki Vandanam in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026–27 is:
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026–27 provided Rs 8,456 crore for Thalliki Vandanam.
accepted.tq: Separate scheme allocations from benefit amounts and other budget figures.

accepted.s: Deepam-2 provides which of the following benefits?
o: Three free LPG cylinders per year to 33.32 lakh families
Three free LPG cylinders per year to 83 lakh families
Two free LPG cylinders per year to 83 lakh families
One free LPG cylinder per month to all households
accepted.x: Deepam-2 provides three free LPG cylinders annually to 83 lakh families.
accepted.tq: Check the combination of benefit, frequency and coverage.

accepted.s: The Stree Shakti scheme provides:
o: Free LPG cylinders for women farmers
Free employment training for all households
Annual cash support to mothers of school-going children
accepted.x: Stree Shakti provides free APSRTC travel for women.
accepted.tq: Distinguish transport support from other welfare benefits.

accepted.s: The number of journeys recorded under the Stree Shakti scheme is:
accepted.x: Stree Shakti recorded 33.32 crore journeys.
accepted.tq: Distinguish journey counts from beneficiary and employment figures.

accepted.s: The jobs component of the Super Six envisages:
accepted.x: The jobs component envisages 20 lakh jobs over five years.
accepted.tq: Test the target and time period together.

accepted.s: The Skill Census associated with the jobs component of the Super Six is the:
accepted.x: The jobs component is associated with Skill Census 2024.
accepted.tq: Distinguish closely placed years in a policy reference.

accepted.s: NTR Bharosa pensions involve an expenditure of how much in 2026–27?
accepted.x: NTR Bharosa pensions account for Rs 27,719 crore in 2026–27.
accepted.tq: Match the expenditure figure with the correct welfare programme.

accepted.s: According to the 16th Finance Commission-related comparison, Andhra Pradesh has the:
o: Lowest per-capita social security pension spend
Highest total GDP expenditure on education
Lowest welfare expenditure among southern States
Highest per-capita social security pension spend
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh is stated to have the highest per-capita social security pension spend.
accepted.tq: Watch for reversed comparative claims.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes Navaratnalu?
o: A self-help group movement based on community participation
A Five-Year Plan focused exclusively on industrial growth
The previous government’s welfare package funded from revenue expenditure
A current central index measuring inclusive development
accepted.x: Navaratnalu was the previous government’s welfare package and was funded from revenue expenditure.
accepted.tq: Identify the programme by its character and funding source.

accepted.s: Under the Zero Poverty P4 approach, which redistribution relationship is proposed?
accepted.x: Zero Poverty P4 proposes that the top 10% support the bottom 20%.
accepted.tq: Avoid reversing the two population groups in a redistribution statement.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the goals associated with Swarna Andhra @2047?
o: End extreme poverty by 2030 and become high-income by 2047
End extreme poverty by 2047 and become high-income by 2030
Achieve high income by 2030 and eliminate inequality by 2047
End poverty by 2026 and achieve high income by 2035
accepted.x: Swarna Andhra @2047 aims to end extreme poverty by 2030 and attain high-income status by 2047.
accepted.tq: Keep the earlier poverty target and later income target in sequence.

accepted.s: In July 2026, the Centre released how much to Andhra Pradesh under VB-G RAM G?
accepted.x: The Centre released Rs 2,545.50 crore to Andhra Pradesh under VB-G RAM G in July 2026.
accepted.tq: Match the current-affairs figure with the correct programme.

accepted.s: Which district ranked first in India in the ADP’s Basic Infrastructure theme in the March 2026 rankings?
accepted.x: Alluri Sitharama Raju (ASR) district ranked first in India in the ADP’s Basic Infrastructure theme.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise location rather than a nearby regional distractor.

accepted.s: Which statement correctly compares the multidimensional poverty headcount ratios of Andhra Pradesh and India?
accepted.x: The multidimensional poverty headcount ratio is 6.06% in Andhra Pradesh compared with 14.96% for India.
accepted.tq: Read the direction of the comparison before checking the figures.

accepted.s: The welfare benefits referred to in the context of Andhra Pradesh are delivered through:
accepted.x: Welfare delivery in Andhra Pradesh is stated to occur through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
accepted.tq: Identify the delivery mechanism rather than the benefit itself.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly captures the contrasting evidence on poverty and inequality?
o: Poverty is rising according to the World Bank, while income inequality is falling according to the World Inequality Database
Poverty is falling according to the World Bank, while income inequality is rising according to the World Inequality Database
Both poverty and income inequality are stated to be rising
Both poverty and income inequality are stated to be falling
accepted.x: The World Bank indicates falling poverty, whereas the World Inequality Database indicates rising income inequality.
accepted.tq: Keep two institutions and their contrasting findings correctly paired.

accepted.s: Which Five-Year Plan was the first to explicitly represent inclusive growth?
accepted.x: The 11th Five-Year Plan was the first inclusive-growth Plan.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the first occurrence from the final occurrence in a sequence.

accepted.s: Which was the last Five-Year Plan of India?
accepted.x: The 12th Five-Year Plan was the last Five-Year Plan.
accepted.tq: Use the endpoint marker to identify the correct Plan.
